# Master-key run: the sample campaign on commit b7e8b092, lore and session both read

Made with `graph_key_check BACKUP --docs both` (the check on #3630's and #3635's branches, so by-design creatures and the
feeling score are included) on the owner's backup of the public sample campaign, exported 2026-11-06 after the next deploy
(`dmbot_commit` b7e8b092, which is the development commit of #3496, so it predates #3631, #3634 and #3641). It holds both
documents read; a lore-only download was not taken, so there is no lore-only row for this commit. Sample names are public.

## At a glance (master key), against the 0f2f9d02 run with the session

| | 0f2f9d02 (both) | b7e8b092 (both) |
|---|---|---|
| Entries found | 69 of 95 | **71 of 95** (22 missing, 22 must-find) |
| Ties found | 43 of 133 | **49 of 133** |
| Ties of the wrong type | 12 | **9** |
| Ties missing | 78 (52 must-find) | **75 (48 must-find)** |
| Extra entries (not in the key) | 11 | **5** |
| Extra ties between key entries | 33 | 23 |
| Must-not-find names present | 2 | **2** |
| Feelings scored | 5 (4 exact, 1 over) | **6 (4 exact, 2 over-read)** |

Gains: associations 0 to 2 of 9, feelings 6 to 9 of 19 (wrong type 2 to 4), work ties 6 to 7, people 30 to 31 of 35, places 24 to 25.
Unchanged: every sacrifice tie, the Ten-Towns places, the special items (3 of 10 found), the party's members.

## What is still wrong

- **Must-not-find names present: "maul barbarian" and "morningstar barbarian"** (the session reader again; "morningstar barbarian"
  came back; the 0f2f9d02 run had only the maul). "owlbear" (lower case, from the session) is also an extra entry; the earlier
  "Owlbears" is gone. This is #3634, fixed on a branch that is not deployed in this build.
- **Two feelings over-read:** m081 Belleros to Brewner (hostile, key wary; unchanged since 0f2f9d02) and the new m129 Belleros to
  Cerric (friendly, key wary). #3631 (the cue guard) is not in this build either.
- **"(unnamed) Okthandom's child" and "(unnamed) Brewner's daughter"** are now unnamed people (the described-person path works for
  these two); they are not in the key's entry list under that spelling, so they count as extras.
- **A stored-data fault, #3650:** a kept `knows` holds "friendly Told by the DM as something that happened to Belleros…" as its
  detail (the note of #2562, run into the detail, #3625). New ones stop with #3628; the stored ones need a data fix, so that fact's
  feeling is lost today.
- Ties of the wrong type (5, must-find): m012, m041 (found, kept as a plain link), m078 (works_in), m091 (knows Claude), m107
  (carries the figurine). m041 and m107 are #3619.

## Not done here

No code, key or setting changed. The next deploy should carry #3631 (cue guard), #3634 (session names), #3628 (the note) and
#3641 (the feeling action), and the run after it should show must-not-find names 0 and the over-reads gone.
